original:
Make a Todo list web app I can use on my phone and my laptop. I can add a task by typing it and pressing Enter or a button, tick a task as done, delete a task, and filter the list by All / Active / Done. The list must still be there after I reload the page. Empty tasks must not be added. It must look usable on a 375px wide phone and on a desktop, with no console errors.

Completion conditions: Every requirement is verified by real checks in a real Chromium (typed input, clicks, reload, both viewports, screenshots), independent Sonnet review and a final Opus audit. A screenshot alone, or a passing build, is not verification. Do not weaken or delete requirements. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only (no build step, no npm packages). Serve index.html as a static file.

requirements.text: Add: typing text and pressing Enter or the Add button appends a task; surrounding whitespace is trimmed; an empty or whitespace-only input adds nothing.
Complete/delete: each task has a checkbox that toggles done (visually distinguishable) and a delete button that removes it.
Filter: All / Active / Done controls show the matching tasks; the active filter is visibly marked; the item counter shows the number of active tasks.
Persistence: tasks, done state and the chosen filter survive a page reload (localStorage); corrupted stored data must not crash the page.
Layout: usable at 375x700 and 1280x800 with no horizontal scroll, controls reachable, and zero console errors.
